remarks: Build, explore, hunt & enjoy your own 10 beautiful acres in Colden! Ideally located at 8049 Irish Road, this vacant parcel offers approximately 744 feet of road frontage and 544 feet of depth, providing plenty of space and possibilities. The seller has already invested in adding a driveway, giving you a great start toward enjoying the property. Whether you're looking for a future homesite, hunting or recreational land, or simply your own private piece of Western New York, this property is worth seeing in person. Enjoy a peaceful country setting with a lovely stream running through the property, while still being just minutes from Kissing Bridge and within the Springville-Griffith Institute School District. With its generous road frontage, the property may also offer potential for subdivision into two building lots—perfect for those hoping to build near family or friends. Buyer to verify subdivision and building requirements with the Town of Colden. Property is not located in a designated flood zone. Bring your builder, walk the land and imagine the possibilities! Aerial boundary lines shown in photos are approximate and for reference only. An incredible opportunity to secure 10 acres and close before 2027!
